name: @continuum/experience-view
description: Shared Experience (Join Contract) projection for Continuum clients — the framework-free decode + Workspace view model that turns a room's Experience manifest (+ its rich roster region payload) into the neutral @continuum/patterns WorkspaceView. The second defineApp consumer after chat-view: one app definition, mounted on web (Lit) / terminal (ANSI) / mobile (Flutter) / RAG. Holds NO transport, NO DOM, NO ANSI; typed against @continuum/sdk-typescript's manifest + view types.
